title: TextSphere: Efficient Text-to-Image Generation via Shared Hyperspherical Alignment and Uniformity
abstract: arXiv:2611.23155v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in text-to-image generation have substantially improved image quality, particularly through diffusion-based methods that require multiple inference steps. In contrast, Sphere Encoder offers an efficient generative framework capable of producing images with fewer forward steps. However, extending it to free-form text is nontrivial, because its class-conditioned design lacks cross-modal alignment. To address this challenge, we propose TextSphere, an efficient text-to-image generative framework that extends Sphere Encoder with language conditioning and cross-modal alignment. translated_title: TextSphere：基于共享超球面对齐与均匀性的高效文本到图像生成
translated_abstract: 文本到图像生成的最新进展显著提升了图像质量，尤其是借助需要多次推理步骤的基于扩散模型的方法。相比之下，Sphere Encoder 提供了一种高效的生成框架，能够以更少的前向步骤生成图像。然而，将其扩展到自由形式的文本并非易事，因为其类条件设计缺乏跨模态对齐。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了 TextSphere，一种高效的文本到图像生成框架，它通过语言条件机制和跨模态对齐对 Sphere Encoder 进行了扩展。我们通过自适应层归一化（AdaLN）引入预训练的 CLIP 文本嵌入来引导图像生成，同时保留原有的球面采样机制。为弥合跨模态表示之间的差距，我们引入了球面语义对齐与均匀性（SSAU）目标，共同促进语义对齐和表示的均匀性（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: TextSphere 通过 AdaLN 引入 CLIP 文本嵌入并提出球面语义对齐与均匀性（SSAU）目标，将高效的 Sphere Encoder 扩展到自由文本条件下，实现仅需少量前向步骤的文本到图像生成。
en_tdlr: TextSphere extends the efficient Sphere Encoder to free-form text-to-image generation by injecting CLIP text embeddings via AdaLN and introducing a Spherical Semantic Alignment and Uniformity (SSAU) objective, enabling high-quality images with only a few forward steps.
